frozen_before: any Supermemory Local run on these thirty questions; the only Kaggle run so far was a plumbing smoke test on 08e075c7, a question already completed on the M2, used for no scoring

reporting: results for these thirty are reported separately, and combined with the first thirty as the stratified sixty, with the machine (M2 or Kaggle T4) recorded per question; the smoke run showed run-to-run variation in Supermemory's extraction (16 vs 25 results on 08e075c7), which is disclosed
